## About
EcoTECH Import Auto Service is an independent repair facility on Watson Road, just minutes from downtown Webster Groves. We specialize in Subaru, Toyota, Nissan, Honda, Volkswagen, Audi, BMW and Porsche, and we pretty much service all European and Asian brands. Not sure about yours? Just ask.
We do manufacturer recommended maintenance, full repairs and customization, and we use OEM parts. Reviewers mention Neil, Misha, Evany and Adam by name, and they talk about people who take the time to explain what's going on with the car.
Should we ever fail to meet your expectations, we'll make it right. We're rated 4.8 from 294 Google reviews.

## Services
- Routine Maintenance: Complete manufacturer recommended services to keep your car running the way it should.
- Full Service Repair: We diagnose, repair or replace engines, transmissions, suspension, computers and the rest of the car.
- Dyno Services: Get your car calibrated on the dyno for more power or better mpg.
- Performance Upgrades: We only use the best brands and parts, and we're happy to give straight advice on what fits your car and how you drive.
- Engine Rebuild Service: Engine rebuilds done in house.
- Check Engine Light: Light on? Bring it in and we'll test it hands on to find the actual cause.
- Oil, Fluids and Filter: Oil changes, fluids and filters, and we'll help you pick the right oil for your car.
- Air Conditioning Service: Keep the A/C working through a St. Louis summer.

## FAQ
Q: Can I bring my own parts?
A: Give us a call before you buy and we'll talk through what you need. We prefer not to install customer supplied parts, and if we do and have to correct problems they cause, that labor is included in the cost.

Q: Can you tell me what's wrong with my car over the phone?
A: Usually not. Cars are complex, and getting it right takes hands on testing and inspection. Call us and we'll get you scheduled.

Q: How often should I have my car serviced?
A: It varies by model, but as a general rule a minor service every 10,000 miles and a major service every 30,000 miles, plus the annual factory scheduled maintenance.

Q: What kind of oil should I use?
A: It depends on your car. Subarus often call for synthetic, and we'll help you figure out what's best for yours and why.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday - Friday, 8:00 am - 5:00 pm. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
